rtc_decision: Original RTC is inference-time PiGDM/VJP guidance and does not require retraining. For an asynchronous queue, this candidate uses training-time clean action-prefix conditioning, tokenwise clean timestep, and suffix-only loss. Continuous synchronous simulation is not itself RTC. Queue wiring and real timing parity are required before claiming asynchronous evaluation.

sources.name: RTC and Training-Time Action Conditioning official implementation
sources.evidence: src/model.py:200-263 implements both VJP guidance and clean-prefix training/inference; README links original 2506.07339 and follow-up 2512.05964
sources.use: Prefix conditioning with a trained delay distribution; no claim that original RTC requires retraining.

sources.name: VLASH original paper
sources.evidence: Section 4.2 trains fixed visual observation with jointly offset future robot state/action; official code mit-han-lab/vlash
sources.use: Timestamp alignment and future-state awareness; cannot substitute for dynamic-object motion updates.

sources.name: Realtime-VLA V2 official implementation
sources.evidence: Triton backend extends realtime-vla with training-time RTC action prefill and time-axis planning
sources.use: Static inference and execution-time alignment; do not conflate trajectory speed with model latency.

sources.name: Flash-WAM official implementation
sources.evidence: Modality-specific consistency distillation for video and action
sources.use: Later step distillation after obtaining a reliable teacher; naive NFE cuts are not equivalent.

sources.name: Efficient-WAM official implementation
sources.evidence: Compact video expert, multiscale future latents, asymmetric video-action denoising
sources.use: Control-relevant coarse dynamics; does not establish exact cross-action-condition KV cache reuse.

sources.name: Fast-WAM official implementation
sources.evidence: Video co-training with optional future-free inference; compiled denoise, batched VAE, CUDA Graph, cached text embeddings
sources.use: System optimization organization; retain DynamicWAM dynamics rather than assume future-free inference is harmless on DOMINO.
